params.prompt: Instantly understandable mobile app ad visual, square 1:1, premium glossy 3D render. COMPOSITION: the hero group is placed in the LOWER-CENTER, occupying only from 38% to 86% of the height and the middle 70% of the width; the upper 34% must stay free of objects (only background atmosphere) for a headline; bottom 12% free. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no money, no coins. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M). Scene: a glossy red-and-white umbrella with an obvious torn hole; raindrops fall through the hole onto Meri, who looks up surprised holding the handle; a red round notification badge with an exclamation mark symbol near the hole. BACKGROUND: rich atmospheric twilight gradient from deep navy at the top to electric blue and soft violet, gentle diagonal rain streaks, warm blurred city bokeh lights near the bottom and a wet glossy floor reflection.
